forecast_LODO.meaning: How accurate are status/predict +4d weight forecasts vs real weigh-ins (Trial 1, leave-one-harvest-day-out).

accuracy_percentages.note: Regression has no single official "accuracy %". approx_accuracy_vs_mean_weight = 100*(1 - MAE/mean true FW). Also report % of cases within an absolute/relative error band.

days_to_target_calibration.meaning: At day t, ask when the plant will reach the weight later measured at t+4; compare predicted days vs actual 4 days. Measures timeline calibration.

recommendation_consistency_model_interna.meaning: Do suggested set-point tweaks move the *model prediction* closer to the goal than doing nothing? Consistency check — not a real greenhouse trial.

trial2_proxy_plant_mean_vs_tray.meaning: Today tray median known; allocate to cups by canopy share; Trial1 AR-Δ per plant; mean plant pred vs tray median @ t+4.

what_we_cannot_claim_yet: We have not run controlled experiments that apply recommended EC/temp and re-weigh plants. Causal accuracy of recommendations needs a real A/B or before/after trial.
